cards.title: Kindness of strangers on family flights
cards.body: A passenger's small gesture of tucking a blanket around a sleeping child made an exhausted parent's international flight with four kids bearable. Unexpected kindness from fellow travelers can transform stressful family travel moments.

cards.title: Should parents reveal will contents to children?
cards.body: Parents of adult children often wonder whether to share inheritance plans in advance or let surprises emerge later. Family therapists note that transparent conversations can prevent resentment and conflict after unexpected will revelations.

cards.title: Family mealtimes and parent-child connection
cards.body: Regular family meals create pause points where parents and children listen to each other and share stories together. This daily ritual strengthens bonds and offers children a secure space for connection.

cards.title: Parenting a reactive child with love
cards.body: One family discovered that what appeared as harsh parenting was actually an effective strategy for reaching their reactive child. Sometimes unconventional approaches help restore peace when traditional methods fail.

cards.title: Postpartum psychosis and maternal mental health
cards.body: Author Jodi Picoult explores trauma and postpartum psychosis in her novel, shedding light on this serious perinatal mental health condition. Understanding postpartum psychosis helps families recognize and seek support for affected mothers.

cards.title: Gun violence exposure harms children mentally
cards.body: Children who witness or hear gunshots experience measurable psychological effects regardless of age. Early intervention and support are crucial for processing this trauma.

cards.title: Martha's Rule improves pediatric hospital care
cards.body: Named after 13-year-old Martha Mills, this rule ensures hospitals listen to family concerns about patient care. The protocol is now rolled out across all A&E departments in England to prevent tragic oversights.

cards.title: Liver transplant gives child new life at 10
cards.body: Ollie thrives a decade after receiving a life-saving liver transplant from 17-year-old donor Miriam. The family credits the selfless donation decision with their son's continued health and happiness.

cards.title: Teen skincare routines from dermatology experts
cards.body: Dermatologists share practical skincare advice for teenagers dealing with acne and skin concerns. Simple routines and adequate sleep are foundational to healthy teenage skin.

cards.title: Leaving home: parenting adult children
cards.body: Sending a child to university brings mixed emotions—joy at their independence alongside bittersweetness at an ended chapter. Parents experience both relief at newfound freedom and nostalgia for their child's presence.
